summary: This bill amends the Noise Control Act of 1972 to require the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency to review and, if necessary, revise or supplement noise criteria every 10 years, with the first review due two years after the bill's enactment.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Noise Control Act of 1972 to establish a deadline for reviewing and revising noise criteria. While noise pollution can be considered an environmental issue, this bill focuses specifically on administrative procedures for noise control rather than broader environmental protection or deregulation. Its impact on the overall environment is indirect and minor.
